name: spin
text: A person turns in place continuously with small pivoting steps, turning through full circles to the left.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 用半圈试片的全身姿态控制完整转圈，脚下小步换支撑，第二圈首尾同姿态。原地转圈循环，非单脚芭蕾旋转。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
